name: Hoshi no Oujo 2
source:
"My little sister who is more important to me than anything... I want you to promise me. I'm sure you will be happy."

It is two years after her beloved parents as well as her older brother die. The protagonist Mirai is now in her third year of university.

"I have to be happy. I have to smile a lot and make my dream come true ...because, I promised big brother."

With sadness still in her heart, she tries to earnestly live.
The people supporting her are her increasing school friends and a number of men.

Her childhood friend who is back from being a soccer player in Italy, Kouhei.
Her dead brothers physician who has now retired from medicine, Hayato.
Her cool headed but somehow shadowed teacher, Shuuji.

"I... like those people."

Gradually the protagonist awakens to her feelings.

--But soon she has an unforeseen meeting, is it a dream or reality?
Worlds are intersecting and something is happening.

"I want to meet that person again once more."

With that strong wish her frozen heart begins to thaw.

An adult love story weaving the tale of two worlds.
"Please, embrace me."
Who will you fall in love with?

[Translated from the [url=http://www.mirai-soft.com/hosi2/intro-2.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
“我最珍爱的妹妹…答应我，你一定要幸福。”

挚爱的父母与哥哥相继离世后，已经过去了两年。主人公未来如今是大学三年级学生。

“我必须幸福，必须常常微笑，还要实现自己的梦想…因为，这是我和哥哥的约定。”

她心中仍怀着悲伤，却努力认真地生活。
陪伴和支持她的，是在学校里日益增多的朋友，以及几名男子。

从意大利足球赛场归来的青梅竹马公平。
曾为亡兄诊治、如今已经不再行医的隼人。
冷静理智，却似乎背负着某种阴影的教师修司。

“我…喜欢那些人。”

主人公渐渐意识到自己的感情。

——然而，一场意想不到的相遇即将来临。那究竟是梦，还是现实？
两个世界彼此交错，某件事情正在发生。

“我想再见那个人一次。”

这份强烈的愿望，让她冰封的心逐渐融化。

一段交织两个世界的成人爱情故事。
“请拥抱我。”
你最终会爱上谁？

[翻译自[url=http://www.mirai-soft.com/hosi2/intro-2.html]官方网站[/url]]
